fhqol.focus.name: Window Focus
fhqol.focus.desc: What the game does with controller input while another window is in front.
fhqol.focus.neutralize.name: Ignore Controls While Window Is Unfocused
fhqol.focus.neutralize.desc: Stops the menu cursor scrolling and the character walking off on their own after you switch away from the game.
fhqol.focus.survey.name: Log Pad State While Focused
fhqol.focus.survey.desc: Diagnostic only. Writes the first few analog and button words to the log so the pad layout can be verified in a running game.
